verdict.rationale: The evidence only lightly supports personalization: Mailgun documents Recipient Variables for batch sending and "Template Variables" with mailing lists, which suggests merge fields. It also mentions "email previews" as a quality-check feature. Nothing describes a templating language with conditionals or loops, or a template test-render step before sending. Missing for 10: a documented templating language/syntax, conditionals, loops, a template test-render/preview API tied to templates, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending
